text:
maria: quick question — noticed node gRPC streaming client drops Authorization after reconnects when using our SDK. anyone seen this?
kevin: hm, you mean reconnects triggered by network blips and the server returns 401 on resumed stream?
maria: yea, exact. first connect is fine, then on retry we get `401` and request headers show no `authorization` header.
sam: do you call the auth header generator per-connection or reuse the metadata object?
maria: reusing the same Metadata instance and doing `metadata.set('authorization', token)` once at startup.
olivia: that might be it — for grpc each new call/stream gets its own metadata; if reconnect does a fresh call the reused metadata object may not be attached. try generating metadata inside the call factory.
kevin: also check any retry middleware — some libs clone the call options but forget to deep-copy metadata. which client are you on (grpc-js or grpc native)?
maria: grpc-js. using our node SDK wrapper v0.9.2 (PR 842).
sam: quick repro snippet i've used:
```js
function callStream(token) {
  const meta = new grpc.Metadata();
  meta.set('authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
  return client.streamMethod(request, meta);
}
```
if you instead create `meta` outside and reuse it across reconnects it can behave oddly.
maria: interesting — i did a cheap fix: regenerate metadata before each `client.streamMethod` call and it fixed reconnect auth.
olivia: other gotcha: windows/pwsh users sometimes have trailing CRLF in the token env var which makes header malformed. use `.trim()` when reading `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
kevin: and base64 basic-auth construction — if you do `Buffer.from(
  `${username}:${password}`
).toString('base64')` make sure password can be empty (username-only basic auth) — empty string still needs the colon.
maria: yes i found a secondary issue: in some places we were skipping `Authorization` when token === '' instead of sending `Authorization: Basic <base64>` with `username:` payload. caused 400 in our proxy.
sam: fwiw, in the SDK we should centralize header construction so everyone benefits. open to a small change in auth.ts to always call a `buildAuthHeader({kind, username, token})` function.
olivia: +1. also add a tiny test that simulates reconnect in `test/stream-reconnect.test.ts` to ensure metadata regenerated.
ci-bot: Build started for PR #842 — tests: unit, lint, smoke-streaming.
kevin: pinging @maria and @sam for a quick code review when you have a sec, i'm OOO in 2h.
maria: i'll post a small PR that moves metadata creation into the call path and adds the pwsh trim check; link in a sec.
sam: thanks — also include a short note in SDK CHANGELOG about the behavior and the windows env-var trim. users keep hitting that.
maria: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/847 — touches auth.ts + stream client tests.
olivia: reviewed, left one nit about a test assertion, otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:
maria: fixed the nit and squashed.
kevin: merged, thanks all.
olivia: will follow up with a short doc blurb in https://redwood-internal/docs/sdk-auth about common env pitfalls.
maria: awesome, thanks for the help!
